lgd_definition: "Livestock Guardian Dog" is a Dog that works and/or lives with domestic farm Animals, including but not limited to sheep, cattle, and poultry, to protect them while repelling predators and is used exclusively for that purpose;
herding_definition: "Herding Dog" means a Dog that has been trained and is actively being used in a bona fide farming operation for the purposes of controlling livestock on the farm;
collar_tag_req: Keep the tag issued by the City securely fixed on the Dog or Cat collar at all times. The Tag may be removed while a Dog is being lawfully used for hunting in the bush or in the case of a Livestock Guardian Dog or Herding Dog, while the Dog is being actively used in farming practices, provided that the Dog is identified by a microchip.
dog_limit: No Person shall Keep or permit to be Kept more than a cumulative total of six (6) Cats and Dogs older than 3 months (12 weeks) of age on any Premises in the City, of which there may only be a maximum of three (3) Dogs.
notes: Contains specific definitions for Livestock Guardian Dog and Herding Dog. Exempts these dogs from wearing a collar/tag while actively working if they are microchipped and registered.

lgd_definition: "Livestock Guardian Dog" means a dog that works and/or lives with domestic farm animals (i.e., cattle, sheep, goats) to protect them while aggressively repelling predators and is used exclusively for that purpose.
collar_tag_req: Every tag that is issued shall be kept securely fixed on the dog at all times when the dog is in a place other than the dwelling of its owner. The owner of a licenced Livestock Guardian Dog may remove the tag from a Livestock Guardian Dog's collar while the dog is being actively used for Livestock protection to repel predators, provided that the owner provides for alternative means of identification.
dog_limit: No person shall keep, or cause to be kept, more than three (3) dogs, three (3) cats or a total of six (6) individual animals, except: ... (5) where the keeping of animals is on lands zoned and used for agricultural, agricultural support or agriculturally related purposes.
notes: Defines Livestock Guardian Dog. Includes agricultural exemptions to dog limits and collar/tag requirements while actively working.

collar_tag_req: A pet owner shall ensure that the identification tag issued by the Municipality is kept securely affixed to its pet at all times.
dog_limit: No person shall keep more than 3 dogs on a property without a permit. Section 3.20 shall not apply to any owner who keeps on property in an Agricultural Zone, ... (d) farming dogs provided the farming dog owner provides proof acceptable to the Municipal Clerk that the dogs are required as part of animal husbandry.
notes: Agricultural exemptions to the dog limit are permitted for farming dogs required as part of animal husbandry on properties zoned Agricultural.

lgd_definition: "Livestock guardian dog" means a dog that (a) is identifiably of a breed this is generally recognized as suitable for the purposes of protection of livestock from predation, and (b) lives with a flock or herd of livestock;
collar_tag_req: The owner shall keep the dog tag securely fixed on the dog at all times until the tag is renewed or replaced, but the tag may be removed while the dog is within the premises of the owner.
dog_limit: In all areas of the Municipality having a lot area of less than 0.4 ha (1 acre) the maximum number of dogs permitted per household shall be two (2). In all areas of the Municipality having a lot area of equal to or more than 0.4 ha (1 acre) the maximum number of dog permitted per household shall be (3).
notes: Defines Livestock guardian dog. Exempts LGDs from outdoor shelter requirements if they have ready access to a structurally sound building used to house livestock.

lgd_definition: "Livestock Guardian Dog" means a dog that works and/or lives with domestic farm animals (e.g., cattle, sheep, poultry) to protect them while repelling predators and is used exclusively for that purpose.
herding_definition: "Herding Dog" means a dog that has been trained and is actively being used in a bona fide farming operation for the purposed of controlling livestock on the farm.
collar_tag_req: Every owner of a dog... shall keep the tag securely fixed... an owner need not keep the tag on his or her dog... if the dog is a Livestock Guardian Dog or a Herding Dog and the dog is being actively used in farming practices, and has been tattooed or implanted with a microchip.
dog_limit: 4 dogs and 6 cats for zoned rural and agricultural. All other zones: Two (2) dogs... Notwithstanding Section 4.2.1 this requirement shall not apply to owners of Livestock Guardian Dogs, Herding Dogs... while such dogs... are kept in an area which is zoned 'agricultural/rural' pursuant to the Zoning By-Law and said dogs are kept for agricultural uses in accordance with their defined function.
notes: Highly farm-friendly bylaw. Includes fee exemptions for LGDs and herding dogs, exempts them from barking restrictions, dog limits, and collar/tag requirements while actively engaged.

collar_tag_req: Failure to display a dog tag is an offence subject to fine.
dog_limit: The total number of dogs owned by all of the persons comprising any one household within the limits of the municipality shall be restricted to three (3)... The restriction in numbers of dogs shall not apply to any licensed Dog Kennel within the Township.
notes: Standard animal control bylaw with no specific farm-friendly LGD provisions mentioned.
